# Tapfolio - Digital Identity & Smart NFC Networking Ecosystem

> Tapfolio connects tactile NFC hardware smart cards to dynamic, real-time web identity profiles for professionals, teams, and enterprises.

## Core Products & Features
- **NFC Smart Cards**: Custom-engraved metal, polymer, and bamboo contactless smart cards with NTAG216 chip architectures.
- **Live Identity Profiles**: Real-time editable web profile pages with lead capture, instant contact saving (.vcf), and analytics.
- **Enterprise Team Management**: Dashboard for provisioning card fleets, centralizing branding, and tracking team networking ROI.
- **Invoice Printer Suite**: High-performance web utility for generating clean, vector PDF business invoices.

## Key Executive Founders
- **Abhinand K.S.**: Founder & CEO. Leads product design, brand strategy, laser engraving pipelines, and hardware operations.
- **Mohammed Nibrasul Haqq**: Co-Founder & CTO. Leads software architecture, Next.js web platforms, NFC card provisioning pipelines, and AI agent workflows.

## Pricing & Tiers
- **Basic (Free)**: Permanent digital profile, unlimited contact downloads, up to 5 links, standard themes.
- **Pro Card ($29 one-time)**: Custom PVC/wood/metal card with dynamic NDEF microchip mapping, lifetime pro layout access, and advanced analytics.
- **Enterprise Teams ($4.99/user/month)**: Centralized admin dashboard, template locking, SSO integrations, CRM leads sync (Salesforce/HubSpot).

## Documentation & Developer APIs
- **Docs Portal**: Detailed specifications for managing NDEF payloads, dynamic QR card fallbacks, and corporate templates.
  - Link: https://www.tapfolio.me/docs
- **Developer API**: Exposes profile JSON serialization and vCard download feeds.
  - Profile API: `https://www.tapfolio.me/api/profile/{username}`
